claim: Instructions can say the private Project OS package is installed when the checkout does not contain it.
evidence: On 2026-11-15 this checkout had no .claude/skills/peter-project-os directory while workflows/AGENT-WORKFLOW.md described that install. The supplied v1.0.0 archive was copied in; check.py then matched MANIFEST.json for all 47 packaged files.

claim: The v1.0.0 helper tests pass with the Python standard library.
evidence: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v inside .claude/skills/peter-project-os reported 24 tests OK after the manifest check. Palette 6, GitHub discovery 10, reuse gate 8.
use_when: Deciding whether those helpers need new dependencies before use.
skip_when: The private package is missing or a packaged file no longer matches MANIFEST.json.

claim: Bytecode left by the helper tests is not a change to the v1.0.0 package.
evidence: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests wrote __pycache__ under the package. check.py then reported those files as unpackaged and exited 1. The checker now skips __pycache__ and .pyc files; workflows/project-os/test_check.py covers that case.
use_when: A package check fails only on bytecode after the helper tests.
skip_when: A packaged source file has a hash mismatch.

claim: A dated discovery or active lesson that names its check closes that dimension until the evidence changes.
evidence: DISCOVERIES.md for 2026-11-15 records separate Project OS passes, including PRs #29, #32, and #34, each declining to repeat the previous audit. Issue #35 separately owns a site and backlog pass.
use_when: A new Project OS invocation overlaps a recorded pass.
skip_when: A source named by that pass changed, or the earlier check was blocked.

claim: The media-democracy report PDF and review scripts build and validate reproducibly using uv with the pinned requirements.
evidence: uv run with reportlab==5.1.0, pypdf==7.0.1, and pdfplumber==0.11.10 compiled research/media-democracy/tools/build_report.py to 40 pages and review_pdf.py passed with 0 blank pages and 0 out-of-page characters.
use_when: Rebuilding or reviewing the research report PDF in a cloud environment without system-wide python packages.
skip_when: The report files or build toolchain change.
